_comment: === CAMERA SETTINGS TEMPLATE FOR HYPERSPECTRAL CAMERAS ===
_instructions: Copy this template and fill in values for your camera. All fields marked REQUIRED must be present.
_bit_depth_note: Effective bit depth: 12 for Mono12 (max 4095), 16 for Mono16/XI_RAW16 (max 65535)
_capture_note: Hardware ROI settings sent to camera API
_crop_note: Additional software crop after capture. null = use full captured image
_shape_note: [height, width] of the FINAL published image after all processing
_axis_order_note: How the FINAL image is organized: 'spatial,spectral' means height=spatial, width=spectral. 'spectral,spatial' means height=spectral, width=spatial.
_flip_spatial_note: Set true to flip the spatial axis (rows) to match RGB camera orientation. Use if hyperspectral image appears vertically mirrored compared to other cameras.
_dispersion_note: Nanometers per pixel in spectral direction
_offset_note: If wavelengths are calculated from a reference pixel (e.g., pixel0_wavelength + offset * dispersion)
_fwhm_note: Full Width at Half Maximum - spectral resolution
camera_notes: Free-form notes about this camera setup
